column3: “bring their petition” renders the petition falling before the LORD as their action.
The BSB makes the people the recipients of the proclamation of the fast.
“Bring” and “took” leave the stated hand implicit.
The BSB turns “from his mouth” into a separate question, “Was it at Jeremiah’s dictation?”, naming Jeremiah.
“tell no one” turns the prohibition on anyone knowing into a command not to tell.
